title: Migration / Export Manifest (v1)
description: Schema for state/migration/<migration_id>/manifest.json, describing one import, export, upgrade, or rollback operation end-to-end: staged first, applied atomically, always with a recorded rollback path. Never contains personal paths, account IDs, IPs, or secrets — locations are symbolic-root-relative and descriptions are sanitized.

source_description.description: Sanitized, human-readable description of the origin (e.g. "Playnite export file, adapter v3"), never a literal personal path or account id.

target_description.description: Sanitized, human-readable description of the destination.

staging_path.description: Symbolic-root-relative staging location. All changes land here first; nothing is written to a live root until atomic publish succeeds.

atomic_publish.description: True when the publish step is a single atomic swap (e.g. directory rename/pointer update) rather than an in-place multi-file write.

checksum_manifest_ref.description: Optional pointer to a bundle-lock manifest or equivalent hash-locked file list used to verify staged output before publish.

rollback_ref.description: Optional id of a prior migration or bundle revision to restore to if this operation must be undone. No auto-purge: prior states referenced here are retained, not deleted, until an operator explicitly prunes them.
